$meta.note: Derived from the 3rd Seerah Competition 2026 campaign (banner + trifold). See brand/references/EXTRACTION.md for what was taken and what was rejected. Colours are sampled by eye from delivered artwork — re-sample from the layered source once it is in brand/references/.
$meta.language: Bangla-primary. English is secondary and optional.

lime.use: THE signature colour. GROUND ONLY — pill headers, icon discs, table headers, fills. Always ink on top (7.07:1). Never as text.

olive-deep.use: GROUND ONLY — section bars, footer bands, contact blocks. Always paper on top (5.19:1).

olive-mid.use: Large text only, ≥24px bold, on paper (3.07:1). Masjid name in headers, secondary headings. Never body copy.

ink.use: Body text and headings on paper (12.69:1) or on lime (7.07:1). Also silhouette illustration.

ink-muted.use: Captions, metadata, secondary lines on paper.

paper.use: Default page ground. Warm cream, never pure white. Also text on olive-deep.

surface.use: Cards and tables raised off paper.

grey-dune.use: Illustration mid-tone only. Not a UI colour.

grey-haze.use: Illustration light tone only. Not a UI colour.

colorRules.note: These are measured, not asserted. Re-run `node scripts/contrast.mjs` after any palette change.
never: lime and olive-deep adjacent as fills (2.89:1 — they muddy)

display.use: Headings in both scripts. Heavy weights only — the reference display lettering is very bold.
display._trackingNote: Bangla is never tracked — letter-spacing splits conjuncts and rides the matra. Latin lockups use type.lockup.

body.use: Body, UI, tables. Carries Bangla AND Latin in one family, so bilingual lines stay visually even. Standard for Bangladeshi screen work.

arabic.use: Quranic text and du'a. Wrap in <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">.

customLettering.note: The campaign display lettering (৩য় সীরাত প্রতিযোগিতা) is hand-drawn, not a typeface. No font reproduces it. Vectorise it into brand/logo/ and place it as SVG. Do not substitute Noto Serif Bengali and call it the same thing.

type._sourceFace: The campaign artwork's body face is NOT Hind Siliguri. Most likely SolaimanLipi or Kalpurush, neither of which is on Google Fonts. See brand/references/TYPE-FINDING.md. Current tokens are a legible stand-in, not a match.

lockup.note: Latin lockups only (the vest wordmark, the footer line). Emitted as --tracking-lockup → `tracking-lockup`.

bn.note: Bangla needs more leading than Latin — ascenders and the matra ride high.

scriptRules.numerals: Bengali numerals (০১২৩৪৫৬৭৮৯) for all dates, times, prices and counts. Latin digits ONLY for phone numbers — that is the local convention, and the reference follows it. Use the `bn` filter.

motif.note: Two tiers. The permanent tier is available to any asset; the campaign tier belongs to a specific event and must not leak onto unrelated material.

permanent.pillHeader: Rounded pill carrying an icon + label. The main structural device for dense content.
permanent.sunDisc: Lime circle used as a ground for illustration or numerals.

campaign.seerah: Desert dunes, camel caravan, birds in flight, palm fronds, mosque line-art watermark. Belongs to Seerah/Hijra themes ONLY. Never on prayer times, donations, or general notices.

banner-landscape.use: Event banner in the shape of the Seerah campaign piece

poster-a4.use: A4 portrait print. Use --format pdf for the press file.

trifold-a4.use: A4 landscape, folds into three panels
